reviews.title: Ads
reviews.text:
This app was the best. I’ve been using it for several years, but lately the ads have been overwhelming. 
Took me a while, but I noticed there is the same app to purchase, but it’s $12! Time to move on. Plenty more out there.

reviews.title: Ads make it hard to use
reviews.text:
I’ve been using this app for years and have thoroughly enjoyed it. Not long ago, I would’ve given it five stars, but now that is ad supported, it’s sometimes difficult to use the app.

On many apps, you can dismiss  an ad. On this app, some of the ads are impossible to dismiss, even after viewing.

If the developers can fix this problem, I’m all for giving it  five stars again, but for now, it’s no more than two.
